description: This PHP source file defines the class 'TestCaseParams' used for managing parameters in integration test cases within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for test case metadata, setup data, expected results, and hooks, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: TestCaseParams
classes.description: A class representing parameters for an integration test case, including setup data, expected results, exceptions, and hooks.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the test case.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the test case.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the test case.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the test case.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Returns the services used in the test case.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Sets the services for the test case.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Returns the factories used in the test case.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Sets the factories for the test case.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes for the test case.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for the test case.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the request body data for the test case.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the request body data for the test case.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: getResultData
methods.description: Returns the expected result data.

methods.name: setResultData
methods.description: Sets the expected result data.

methods.name: getResultMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the expected result.

methods.name: setResultMeta
methods.description: Sets metadata about the expected result.

methods.name: getInvalidOnly
methods.description: Returns data about invalid inputs.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Returns true if only invalid data is being tested.

methods.name: setInvalidOnly
methods.description: Sets data about invalid inputs.

methods.name: getExceptionClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of an expected exception.

methods.name: setExceptionClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of an expected exception.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Returns the message of an expected exception.

methods.name: setExceptionMessage
methods.description: Sets the message of an expected exception.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the DateTime object representing the current time for the test case.

methods.name: setNowFromArray
methods.description: Sets the current time from an array with 'datetime' and optional 'timezone'.

methods.name: getHooks
methods.description: Returns the hooks defined for the test case.

methods.name: getHook
methods.description: Retrieves a specific hook by name, if callable.

methods.name: setHooks
methods.description: Sets hooks for the test case.
